summary: Improved parsePriority to correctly handle zero, negative, NaN, and non-numeric inputs. Now explicitly validates input types and value ranges, returning 0 for null/undefined, 1 for invalid inputs or zero, clamps values above 10 to 10, and enforces a minimum priority of 1 for positive inputs. This ensures safer and more predictable behavior aligned with priority conventions.
